query: SELECT v.id,v.uuid,v.instance_name,v.state,h.private_ip_address,d.template_version,d.scripts_version,d.software_version,t.name FROM vm_instance v JOIN domain_router d ON d.id=v.id LEFT JOIN host h ON h.id=v.host_id JOIN vm_template t ON t.id=v.vm_template_id WHERE (t.uuid='5603f424-b342-4dcd-945f-96c009b1bd5b' OR v.uuid='f936aa25-8df0-46c8-814c-db7d0ff6c761') AND v.removed IS NULL;
